title: Tanzanian Chicken Coconut Cream
community: Zanzibar — the luxury coastal chicken preparation
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Kuku wa Cream ya Nazi — Zanzibar chicken simmered in pure thick coconut cream with garlic, ginger, cardamom, and coriander. The most luxurious, richest chicken preparation on the Tanzanian coast — the coconut cream creates a sauce of extraordinary richness.
longDesc: Chicken in coconut cream is the Zanzibar kitchen at its most indulgent — the pure thick coconut cream (not milk) creates a sauce that is richer and creamier than any dairy-based preparation. The cardamom and coriander perfume the coconut cream into something ethereal.
steps: Cook onions until golden. Add garlic, ginger, cardamom, and turmeric.
Simmer very gently (never boil) for 30—35 minutes until chicken is cooked and sauce is thick.
Add lemon juice and coriander. Serve.
chefTips: Coconut cream — not coconut milk. The difference in richness is dramatic.
Gentle simmer throughout — boiling coconut cream splits it.
Lemon at the end brightens the richness.
commonMistakes: Using coconut milk instead of cream.
cookingScience: Coconut cream (25% fat) produces a naturally thickening sauce as the water evaporates during gentle simmering — concentrating the fat into a creamy coating. Hard boiling breaks the emulsion, producing a greasy, separated sauce.
sustainabilityTips: Coastal Tanzanian coconut cream — zero food miles.
culturalNote: Kuku wa Cream ya Nazi is the Zanzibar kitchen's most indulgent preparation — a dish that demonstrates what coconut cream can do when treated with the respect it deserves. It is the chicken dish that makes guests close their eyes when they taste it.
